refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: org.varlink.service is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# General Varlink service interface interface org.varlink.service
# Get service meta information method GetInfo() -> ( # String identifying the vendor of this service vendor: string, # String identifying the product implementing this service product: string, # Version string of this product version: string, # Web URL pointing to additional information about this service url: string, # List of interfaces implemented by this service interfaces: []string )
# Get description of an implemented interface in Varlink IDL format method GetInterfaceDescription( # Name of interface to query interface description of interface: string ) -> ( # Interface description in Varlink IDL format description: string )
# Error returned if a method is called on an unknown interface error InterfaceNotFound( # Name of interface that was called but does not exist interface: string )
# Error returned if an unknown method is called on an known interface error MethodNotFound( # Name of method that was called but does not exist method: string )
# Error returned if a method is called that is known but not implemented error MethodNotImplemented( # Name of method that was called but is not implemented method: string )
# Error returned if a method is called with an invalid parameter error InvalidParameter( # Name of the invalid parameter parameter: string )
# General permission error error PermissionDenied()
# A method was called with the 'more' flag off, but it may only be called with the flag turned on error ExpectedMore()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE org.varlink.service shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE org.varlink.service.GetInfo '{}' invokes its GetInfo method.
